findings.title: Preserve the JavaScript UI interpolation syntax
findings.body: This resource uses i18next-style double-brace placeholders, but the new message replaces them with Java MessageFormat placeholders and a choice expression. The JavaScript UI will not interpolate {0}, {1}, or {2}, or evaluate the choice expression, so multivalued-size validation errors display raw formatting syntax instead of the attribute and limits. The same regression is introduced in the admin-ui English resource at line 3138. Keep the UI-compatible format unless its consumers are also changed.

findings.title: Restore Lithuanian OTP setup instructions
findings.body: The replacement totpStep1 text is Italian, not Lithuanian. Lithuanian users now receive OTP installation instructions in the wrong language. The identical Italian replacement is also introduced for loginTotpStep1 in the Lithuanian login resource at line 71; both should be translated into Lithuanian.

findings.title: Validate HTML inside choice branches rather than discarding it
findings.body: For error-invalid-multivalued-size and linkExpirationFormatter.timePeriodUnit messages, normalization removes the entire choice expression before HTML validation. A translation such as {0,choice,0#<script>alert(1)</script>|1#value} therefore passes verification because the executable markup is replaced with '...'. MessageFormat emits the selected branch at runtime, so this creates a bypass of the new HTML safety check. Handle the choice operator's '<' without excluding branch contents from validation.
